title: Good: search query field injection prevention
description: search.rs:91-106 sanitizes Tantivy query input by truncating to 500 chars and stripping field:value prefix patterns (id:, account_id:, content:) to prevent users from querying internal fields like post IDs or account IDs. The fallback on parse failure creates a simple term query rather than returning an error, which is the right UX choice. The query parser is scoped to content_field only, providing a second layer of defense.
